scenes.setting: The carriage interview: one lead is an ancient tomb by the Stratford River at White Cliff Town — Human-skinned Shadow traces, an exploration party that never came back, and a family name that stops him cold, Amon; the other is a chestnut-haired High-Sequence woman in black leather boots who will trade any sub-High-Sequence ingredient for one thing — the true identity of the Hero Bandit Dark Emperor
scenes.text_anchor: “Investigate Hero Bandit Dark Emperor’s true identity.”
